name: Dunkleosteus
provenance: Late Devonian (Famennian), Cleveland Shale, Ohio, USA
description: Deep-bodied arthrodire with rigid cranial and thoracic armour, articulated gnathal cutting plates and a muscular posterior body.
notes: Original reconstruction informed by Engelman 2024, rather than a specimen scan.
Rear body, caudal outline, oral soft tissues and pigmentation remain interpretations.
Representative 3.35 m adult, not a genus maximum.
Growth is a relaxed maturation pose; no scale animation or moulting.
Armour boundaries are interpreted living plate outlines; detailed sutures should not be used as a research diagram.
